title: 💳 Galaxy AI May Go Paid: Your Custom Cards Could Need a Subscription!
body: 💳 Galaxy AI May Go Paid: Your Custom Cards Could Need a Subscription!

New reports suggest Samsung may soon launch a paid subscription for Galaxy AI services, a move that could put some AI features on its phones behind a monthly fee. According to a leaked support page, users will need to upgrade to a paid plan to create more than three custom cards in the Now Brief feature, which shows you a summary of your day, your appointments and your reminders in smart cards on your screen.

The free standard plan, meanwhile, will keep the current limit of just three cards, while creating and editing cards will consume credits from the paid AI plan, according to the support page. Samsung has not yet announced the plan's name, price or official launch date, and the details remain in the realm of leaks.

This comes as phone makers turn AI features into a recurring revenue stream, after years of offering them free to attract users. The question now: will people accept paying for features they grew used to getting free, or will free rivals steal them away?
Simply put: a free feature on your phone could become a monthly subscription — would you pay for smart cards that know your day?
